verdict.rationale: Built-in AI-assisted authoring is a fair question for a voice agent platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no evidence of it. The prompting docs cover system prompts that the user writes themselves. A/B testing of configurations is manual comparison, not AI-generated content. The CLI's MCP server lets external AI coding tools call Deepgram APIs, which is not the platform's own AI generating prompts, flows, or test cases from a description.
